body:
Closes #87

## Summary

**CONVERSION_BLOCKED / DSN_RULE_TRANSFER_UNQUALIFIED / MAIN_UNQUALIFIED.** Both public KiCad 9.0.9 DSN exports (small fixture + Main) introduce **0.05 mm smd_smd clearance** alongside ordinary 0.20 mm. Official source hardcodes /4; documented Freerouting 2.1.0 `-dr` has its function removed in that version's source, and inspected public CLI settings expose no material-clearance override. The evaluated fixed public configuration path did not establish faithful rules. Stage-C STOP at **2026-10-14 20:52:37.127596 UTC**, before any routing. This is a bounded prerequisite result, not method-wide impossibility or fixed-placement routing failure.

Main initial / confirmation / small routing **0 / 0 / 0**. DSN exports **2** are preparation, not roundtrips. Routed acceptance metrics **null**. No SES or routed Main.

## Scope and acceptance evidence

- Confirmed Issue #87 and PR #86 merge; clean main `49ebe146a586bf820a747b93951a29fe94f08623`, fetched then created the requested branch. Only this Issue/current PO instruction authorizes work.
- Reused saved Main/contracts/libraries/code after hash checks. Five immutable source/lock files individually match `b84585e`; production/source/CI conditions unchanged.
- Fresh Main readback and independent per-land/net/NC/geometry/local-bond parity pass. New ERC **0**; DRC **61 known printing warnings**, plus **127 expected pre-route unconnected items**.
- Main-copy **actual 0.10 mm gap** is detected against required **0.20 mm**, with exact track UUIDs. Original project bytes unchanged.
- Actual saved/reloaded tiny PCBs verify **via joining / missing-via disconnection / wrong-net contact** with the same factored Main copper graph. Old synthetic cases are not substituted. Main baseline regression identical; no expectation changes.
- Small fixture has duplicate pads, NC SMD, PTH, NPTH and local copper. Both raw DSNs fail typed-rule reconciliation before routing. Complete individual DSN geometry/NC/duplicate/hole/layer/bond checks and SES return **not completed**.
- No weakened-rule route, speculative `-dr`, generated-DSN correction, router modification, setting exploration, Main retry, fresh confirmation, manufacturing, Wing, product work, adoption, Human Gate or merge.

## Corrections and limits

Preserved raw preparation failures: system Python venv lacked ensurepip (fixed using host Python matching old geometry hashes), generic SWIG parent was not a typed FOOTPRINT (fixed via public BOARD.GetFootprints), one read-only official-source URL returned404 (not capability evidence). Former scope breach/budget uncertainty from PR #86 remain historical; merge is accepted STOP reporting, not retroactive authorization.

All 61 printing warnings and glyph uncertainty remain manufacturing issues; USB NPTH pre-order DFM and unresolved product conditions remain open. Full routed acceptance / same-condition confirmation / whole-environment reconstruction **unqualified**.

## Documentation / Dashboard

[New report](docs/issue-87-native-main-routing.md), new evidence root, authoritative project-status, EDA history and Dashboard synchronized. PR #86 remains accepted historical STOP, separate from this result.

## Verification / CI

Local submission checks: **1062 prior files unchanged**, **301 new process records** with raw/artifact hashes, saved negative-test evidence, immutable-input hashes, Python AST, documentation links, Dashboard JS syntax and Node VM current-record substitution. No browser visual check claimed. Raw whitespace logs are losslessly gzip archived, not edited/suppressed.

Final HEAD **47bb0e62f4e60b469139bd4584383e67f5de8eaf**: [engineering-ci run38636545119](https://github.com/ihsinoky/he-piantor-42/actions/runs/38636545119) **success**. Detect engineering changes / Engineering gate **success**. KiCad ERC/DRC / Layout generator / Sensor-test firmware **skipped**. Vercel and Vercel Preview Comments **success**. No failed jobs observed. tscircuit bootstrap workflow was not triggered by these paths; qualification experiments did not run in CI. CI is not Main acceptance.

## Time

New six-hour frame begins **2026-10-14 20:46:26 UTC**; experiment STOP after **6m11.128s**. Reporting, commit/push/PR and CI waiting remain charged. Committed effort ledger is a pre-final-commit checkpoint. Closing observation **2026-10-14T20:59:15.233896+00:00**, elapsed **769.234s (12.82min)** including preparation/process waits, reporting, both commits/pushes, PR creation and final-head CI observation. This PR-body update and final-response seconds follow that timestamp and are not independently bounded to the second; conservatively report **about13min total**. Session finished before the one-hour checkpoint was due; no one-hour progress claim is fabricated. No PO waiting or unattended-time exclusion. Process overlap is not double-counted; initial dispatch/final-response seconds are not independently measured. No historical compliance or exact older remaining budget is certified.

## Next PO decision

Review the bounded rule-transfer STOP, then decide whether to authorize a specifically scoped, independently checked rule-transfer correction or hold further investment. Next execution is not authorized by this report. **Draft evidence submission; do not merge automatically.**
